name: a pair that matches on time alone is no evidence: it scores 0 and an unrelated event stays free
notes: §5.3 v1.11 content gate: a (claim, candidate) pair scores 0 unless at least one applicable content feature (every feature but timeProximity: counterpartyExact, counterpartyDomain, counterpartyName, subjectOverlap, amountExact, merchantMatch) scores above 0. Time says when, never which action. Score 0 is below thresholds.partial (> 0 by §5.3), so such a pair is never assigned and never verifies.

Story (the Calendar simulator's CAL-SIM-5). At 09:00 muse falsely says it created 'Dentist' on Wed 10-07 10:00 (c1) and that it created 'Team lunch' on Thu 10-08 12:30 (c2). At 09:40 it really creates 'Board prep' on Wed 10-07 13:00, and the 'Team offsite' event on Thu 10-08 12:30 is new too. The pass at 09:41, which follows changes since 08:00, stores both as calendar.created rows first seen 09:41: o1 'Board prep', o2 'Team offsite'. Coverage: acct-a (bound), every calendar, [10-04 00:00, 10-18 00:00], changesSince 08:00, last synced 09:41. Batch at 09:45.

Subject-only calendar claims: applicable timeProximity 2500 and subjectOverlap 1500 (no counterparty); Σw = 4000. The calendar edge is calendarDays = 259 200 000 ms, toleranceMin 60 000 ms. Both claims are first-seen-eligible for both rows (first seen 09:41 ≥ start(09:00) − 2 min = 08:58).

c1 'Dentist' (window [10-04 10:00, 10-10 10:00]) × o1 'Board prep': Δ = 3 h = 10 800 000 ms → tp = (259 200 000 − 10 800 000)/(259 200 000 − 60 000) = 4140/4319; subject {dentist} vs {board, prep} → 0. The only content feature scored 0, so S = 0/1. Without the gate (v1.10) S = 2500·(4140/4319)/4000 = 5175/8638 ≈ 0.599 ≥ 1/2: c1 would take o1 as PARTIAL evidence, FINAL, and the real claim for 'Board prep', read later, would find its only candidate fixed to c1 and be NOT_FOUND.

c1 × o2 'Team offsite' (10-08 12:30, in c1's window): subject 0 → S = 0/1. c2 'Team lunch' (window [10-05 12:30, 10-11 12:30]) × o2: Δ = 0 → tp 1; subject {team, lunch} vs {team, offsite} = 1/3 > 0, so the gate passes: S = (2500 + 1500·1/3)/4000 = 3000/4000 = 3/4. c2 × o1: subject 0 → S = 0/1.
Assignment (§4.3): the only pair ≥ 1/2 is (c2, o2) at 3/4 → c2 takes o2. c1's candidates are then o1 alone: best 0/1, not assigned.

c1: coverage full (the entry contains [10-04 10:00, 10-10 10:00], every calendar, the bound account, synced 09:41 ≥ end(09:01) + graceMin 30 = 09:31); graceElapsed; bestScoreLt partial → not_found → NOT_FOUND, FINAL. The grant binds gcal.event → no coverage.account_unbound. Reasons: match.best {o1}.
c2: 3/4 = 30 000 000 / 4000 ≥ 5000 bp and < 8500 bp → partial → PARTIAL, FINAL (graceElapsed: 09:41 ≥ 09:31). Reasons: match.best {o2}.

o1 is an orphan: assigned to no claim, inside the entry's window, and a change the entry followed (changesSince 08:00 < first sighting 09:41 ≤ lastSyncAt 09:41; no entry began comparing at 09:41). Anchor (§7, calendar): its first sighting 09:41. muse's session ping at 09:40 is within ±10 min → 4000; idle [09:30, 09:45] covers [09:39, 09:41] → 3000; 7000 bp = 7/10 ≥ 6000 → UNASKED, reasons unasked.session and unasked.idle {agent: muse}. PENDING: muse's adapter synced 09:45 < 09:41 + beforeClaimMin 2 + graceMin 30 = 10:13, and 09:45 < 09:41 + 24 h. When muse's real claim for 'Board prep' is read, it takes o1 and supersedes this receipt (§7).
